title:
Coinbase CEO: The US Needs "Shenzhen-Style" Special Economic Zones

 In an interview on the Relentle
content:
Coinbase CEO: The US Needs "Shenzhen-Style" Special Economic Zones

 In an interview on the Relentless podcast, Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong @brian_armstrong  called for the US to establish Special Economic Zones similar to global hubs like Shenzhen, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Dubai. He believes these red-tape-free "innovation sandboxes" are essential for accelerating industries like crypto, biotech, and drones. Looking ahead, he envisions a future featuring cyberpunk-style free cities.

title: According to EmberCN, Chainlink completed its routine quarterly unlock around an hour ago, moving 19
content:
According to EmberCN, Chainlink completed its routine quarterly unlock around an hour ago, moving 19M LINK (about $165M) from 3 non-circulating supply addresses.

About 14.375M LINK ($125M) was sent to Binance, while 4.625M LINK ($40.1M) went to multisig address 0xD50...8Af. Chainlink typically carries out a similar unlock every ~3 months, with most tokens sent to exchanges and a smaller portion used for staking rewards.
